summary.en: Any distance along a line: the strongest piece.
summary.zh: 沿直线走任意距离，是最强的棋子。

text.en: The chariot moves any number of points along a file or rank, as long as nothing is in the way.
text.zh: 车沿纵线或横线走，只要路上没有棋子，走多远都行。

text.en: Collect the stars with your chariot in as few moves as you can.
text.zh: 用车吃掉星星，步数越少越好。

text.en: The black horse is unprotected. Take it!

hint.en: Your chariot has a clear path up its file.
hint.zh: 你的车沿着纵线一路畅通。

success.en: Free piece! A chariot is worth about two horses.
success.zh: 白得一子！一个车大约值两个马。

text.en: Which piece is usually the strongest?

explanation.en: The chariot controls whole lines. A saying goes: 三步不出车，必定要输棋 — if your chariots aren't out within three moves, you're in trouble.
explanation.zh: 车能控制整条线。俗话说“三步不出车，必定要输棋”。
